episode_title: From Lorry Driver to Award-Winning Garage Owner | Dave Wilson, Drive Green

real_qa.q: How did Dave Wilson transition from lorry driving to owning Drive Green Vehicle Services?
real_qa.r: Dave Wilson started Drive Green Vehicle Services eight years ago while still lorry driving, beginning with carbon cleaning using hydrogen technology after investing in equipment to pay off debt. He set up a Facebook page with no connections in the trade and gradually shifted focus to DPF cleaning after learning about it from a mechanic, eventually quitting lorry driving after realizing he could earn a week's wages in a single day doing DPF cleans.
real_qa.requete: Dave Wilson Drive Green Vehicle Services lorry driver

real_qa.q: What was Dave Wilson's first carbon cleaning job and how did he find his first customer?
real_qa.r: Dave Wilson's first customer was a silver Jeep Cherokee found through a poster he paid to place at a local car wash. He dropped the initial price from £75 to £50 for the job and even did a couple of cars for free initially, borrowing tools from friends when he lacked proper equipment like jubilee clips and hose pliers.
real_qa.requete: Drive Green first customer silver Jeep Cherokee carbon cleaning

real_qa.q: How did Dave Wilson learn DPF cleaning without formal training?
real_qa.r: Dave Wilson learned DPF cleaning through YouTube research, particularly following a channel called On Car Cleaner. He initially invested £300 in additional equipment despite earning only about £600 per week, then purchased a £600 diagnostics tool to handle engine light errors, eventually discovering through trial and error the secret menu process that allowed him to properly reset fault codes.
real_qa.requete: Dave Wilson DPF cleaning YouTube diagnostics tool learning

real_qa.q: What made Dave Wilson decide to leave lorry driving and commit full-time to Drive Green?
real_qa.r: After being let go from his second lorry driving job due to cost-cutting by his employer, Dave was mistreated at a new haulage company and decided to pursue his business full-time. His father's terminal illness also influenced his decision, as he wanted to remain available for family emergencies rather than committing to long-distance lorry driving that might separate him from his dying father.
real_qa.requete: Dave Wilson quit lorry driving full-time garage

real_qa.q: What was Dave Wilson's financial situation when starting Drive Green Vehicle Services?
real_qa.r: Dave Wilson initially invested two thousand pounds in carbon cleaning equipment while earning decent money as a lorry driver but spending equally well, leaving him in a precarious financial position. He had two children and accumulated debt that motivated him to start the side business, though he remained concerned about basic household bills and caring for his family during his transition to full-time business ownership.
real_qa.requete: Dave Wilson startup capital investment two thousand pounds

guest.bio_context: Dave Wilson transitioned from lorry driving to founding Drive Green Vehicle Services approximately eight years ago, starting with carbon cleaning using hydrogen technology while still employed as a truck driver. He built the business without formal technical training or financial backing, learning diagnostics and DPF cleaning through self-directed research on YouTube and online resources. His garage has earned awards and he has successfully scaled the operation from a side business to a full-time automotive service provider.
